title: `with` expressions require record (or struct) types, not class
symptoms: CS8858: The receiver type is not a valid record type and is not a struct type
bad_pattern: class MyResult { ... }  // used with `result with { ... }` elsewhere
explanation: C# `with` expressions only work on record or struct types. If a model type is used with `with { ... }` anywhere, declare it as `record`, not `class`.
